data.title: Bitcoin Price Wobbles as Leverage Falls Ahead of CLARITY Vote and Fed Decision
data.description: Bitcoin open interest fell by 13.5% in 10 days, dropping from 321,497 BTC to 278,151 BTC even as the underlying price declined only about 5% over the same window.
